class.name: WorldDunesDecorator
class.brief_description: Creates gently warped, directional sand dunes.
class.description: Combines a main sinusoidal cross-section with a weaker harmonic and broad sideways warp. Wavelength controls spacing; amplitude controls relief. This is an analytic dune shape, not wind simulation. Shared elevation, seed, composition, material and interior controls are inherited from [WorldTerrainDecorator].
